description: The four battlegrounds: Abermenai (15-19), Thidranki (20-24), Murdaigean (25-29), Caledonia (30-35). Generic lines use {bg}.

lines.text: Fighting in {bg} today. Small skirmishes, big lessons.
Stick together. Lone runners in {bg} do not last long.
First time in Abermenai. Everyone here hits harder than the monsters back home.
Thidranki Faste is changing hands again. Who is with me?
Dun Murdaigean is ours to take. Group up outside the portal keep.
Caer Caledon needs defenders. Thirties, to the keep!
Small fights out here teach more than any trainer ever did.
Holding the bridge to the central keep. Need a couple more swords.
Our portal keep is quiet. Everyone must be out at the center.
Who is heading to the central keep? I would rather not go alone.
{bg} is busy tonight. Saw three groups on the road already.
Just learned the hard way to stay out of archer range.
{enemyrealm} has a big force moving down the east road.
Lost my first duel in {bg}. Won the second, so I call it even.
If you see a stealther, call it out. They pick off the stragglers.
Healers, stay behind the tanks and keep moving.
First rule of {bg}: never chase into their guards.
My first realm points! Felt better than any level.
Central keep door is down to half. Keep pounding!
Ram is up at the gate. Somebody guard it.
Running back from the portal keep. Hold the line a little longer.
They are camping the portal exit again. Come out together, not one at a time.
Bring potions, bring friends, bring patience.
This is how the real realm war feels, only smaller.
Quiet out here. Too quiet. They are massing somewhere.
Two {enemyrealm} scouts on the hill north of the keep.
Keep forgetting to look behind me. Died twice to the same assassin.
Our flag is over the central keep again. Nice work, all.
The keep changed hands three times this hour. Madness.
Group forming at the portal keep for a push on the center.
Need a healer for a small roaming group. We stick to the roads.
Wish I had trained my weapon more before coming here.
A good group of eight can hold this whole field.
Watch the treeline by the river. Archers love that spot.
Practicing assists out here. Pick one target and everyone hit it.
{guild} is holding the central keep. Come help us keep it.
Guild, anyone in {bg} tonight? Could use a few friendly faces.
Every fight here makes me better for the frontier.
Someday I will storm a real frontier keep. For now this will do.
Their casters are out of power. Charge now!
Hold the doors, I hear rams.
My armor is more dents than metal after tonight.
Funny how the {enemyrealm} always show up right after we take the keep.
Stay on the road, the hills are full of stealthers.
Calling it a night. {bg} wore me out.
One more push on the center and then I need to repair.
The {enemyrealm} fight dirty here. Good. So do we.
Learning crowd control the hard way. Mezz first, ask later.
Who has the most kills tonight? I am at a respectable two.
Sound off if you are still alive out there.
Everyone regroup at the crossroads.
Their whole group just wiped on our guards. Ha!
If you die, release and come back. The keep needs every blade.
Spotted a {enemyrealm} group of six heading for our portal keep.
Taking the long way around to flank them.
Nothing beats the noise of a keep door giving way.
My hands are shaking. That fight was close.
Ten minutes in {bg} and I already need a rest.
When outnumbered, fall back to our guards.
Pets and archers to the walls, tanks to the gate.
Practice your positionals here before the frontier eats you alive.
Cannot believe I just beat a {enemyrealm} two levels above me.
Keep lord is down! The center is ours!
Watch your endurance, do not burn it all on the run in.
Our realm owns {bg} tonight.
Just a quick roam before bed. Anyone want to come?
Moving out from the portal keep in a minute. Last call.
I like the battlegrounds. Everyone is close to my level for once.
The walls are thin but the defenders are stubborn.
Spent all my arrows on one healer. Worth it.
Stealth is a gift out here. Nobody sees me coming.
My pet holds the gate better than half of you.
Out of power again. Sitting behind the keep wall to recover.
Heals are thin tonight, so do not overextend.
Shield up, sword out. Tank coming through.
{guild} roams {bg} tonight. Small group, big trouble.
Somebody tell me why the enemy always has more healers.
Is it wrong that I enjoy defending more than attacking?
Practice here, conquer the frontier later. That is my plan.
Right behind you, keep the pace up.
Count me in for this skirmish.
Careful, I just saw movement on the ridge.
Agreed. Stick close to the guards.
On my way from the portal keep.
Give me a moment to rest and I will join.
Ha, I know that feeling all too well.
Watch your back, stealthers about.
Good. Let them come to us.
I will cover the left flank.
Keep the healers safe and we win this.
That is the spirit. For {realm}!
Fair point. I will stay near the walls.
Sounds like a plan. To the center, then.
Heard. Moving up to the walls now.
Let me buff up first, then I am yours.
We hold them here or not at all.
Lead the way to the keep, I will follow.
Careful, they had a healer with them last time.
Aye, let us do it properly this time.
Good luck out on the field.
Every fight teaches something. Keep at it.
I can hold the door if someone watches my back.
Right, regroup first, then push.
Just do not chase too far.
Hah, the {enemyrealm} never learn.
Make room, I am coming through.
Same here, my legs are tired of running.
Guild, I am with you. Hold on.
Better together than alone out here.
Abermenai is my first taste of the realm war. My knees are shaking.
Dun Abermenai needs defenders. Anyone close?
Gathering at our portal keep in Abermenai for a run at Dun Abermenai.
Fifteen and already fighting for the realm. Abermenai, here I come.
This field feels like a playground until the {enemyrealm} show up.
Dun Abermenai changed hands again. We take it back tonight.
Everybody in Abermenai is still learning. That is what makes it fun.
Two more levels and I age out of Abermenai. Making them count.
Hold Dun Abermenai and the {enemyrealm} will break on its walls.
Lost my way in Abermenai. Which road leads to the central keep?
The {enemyrealm} keep running into Dun Abermenai one at a time. Easy pickings.
Small skirmish group forming for Abermenai. Quick and quiet.
Guild, off to Abermenai to learn what fighting real foes is like.
First kill in Abermenai! A real {enemyrealm}, not a rat.
Someone tell the {enemyrealm} that Dun Abermenai is ours.
Nights in Abermenai are chaos. Everyone runs everywhere.
Never thought a level fifteen could matter this much in a fight.
Taking my first realm points home from Abermenai.
In Abermenai the brave die first. I am trying to be second.
{guild} is heading into Abermenai. Join us if you are fifteen to nineteen.
You learn to look around before sitting down in Abermenai.
Our flag flies over Dun Abermenai. Hold it as long as you can!
These Abermenai fights are short and sweet. Mostly short.
Call targets in Abermenai or we lose every fight.
Stuck between two {enemyrealm} groups in Abermenai. Send help!
Portal keep in Abermenai is safe. Rest up and come back out.
One good healer could turn Abermenai around tonight.
My first time storming Dun Abermenai. Lead on.
Gate of Dun Abermenai is weak! All hands to the door!
Best fights for our levels are in Abermenai. No contest.
Round three in Abermenai. Let us win this one.
Brought every potion I own to Abermenai. Probably not enough.
Sixteen in Abermenai is humbling. Everyone else seems seventeen.
Fell off the wall of Dun Abermenai. Do not tell anyone.
Watching the veterans of Abermenai has taught me plenty.
Right with you. Abermenai is ours tonight.
Coming from the portal keep now, hang on.
Keep your head down, they have archers on the walls.
We all start somewhere. Abermenai is a fine place for it.
Stay close to me and we both live.
I age out soon too. Let us go out with a bang.
Abermenai has taught me more than any trainer.
Ha, those first realm points are the sweetest.
Nerves go away after a few fights, trust me.
I will watch for stealthers while you go.
Agreed, small groups do best in Abermenai.
Heading your way. Do not die before I get there.
They will not take it from us twice.
Good. More fighting, less running.
Wait for me, almost to the keep.
Thidranki tonight? I hear the Faste is under siege.
Twenty at last. Thidranki, here I come.
Everyone remembers their first night in Thidranki.
The walls of Thidranki Faste are full of {enemyrealm} archers.
Need more bodies at the Faste gate in Thidranki!
Fights in Thidranki are bigger than I expected. Whole groups clashing.
Rams are rolling toward Thidranki Faste. Defenders to the gate!
Guild, Thidranki run in a bit. Bring your best gear.
{guild} is taking Thidranki Faste back tonight.
Lost Thidranki Faste again. Regroup at the portal keep.
Thidranki is where I learned to love the realm war.
If you hold Thidranki Faste for an hour, you have earned your supper.
So many stealthers in Thidranki. Keep your eyes moving.
My first real keep fight was at Thidranki Faste. Still proud of it.
Twenty two feels about right for Thidranki. Not too green, not too old.
Hold the bridge in Thidranki and they cannot reach the Faste.
Our flag over Thidranki Faste! Well fought, everyone!
Every level in Thidranki makes the fights a bit easier.
The {enemyrealm} have three groups pushing the Faste. Thidranki needs us.
Buffs up before you walk out into Thidranki. Trust me.
Running Thidranki in a small group tonight. Tank and healer wanted.
That Faste never stays ours for long. That is half the fun.
Saw a {enemyrealm} healer keep a whole group alive in Thidranki. Impressive.
Thidranki teaches you to fight as a group or not at all.
Two more levels and Thidranki is behind me. I will miss it.
Camped at the Faste door in Thidranki for ages. Worth every minute.
Grabbed a spot on the walls of Thidranki Faste. Arrows away!
Watch the hills around Thidranki Faste. Stealthers wait there.
Feels like a real war in Thidranki tonight. Banners everywhere.
Lord of Thidranki Faste is down! Hold the keep!
Thidranki gave me my first real rival. A {enemyrealm} who never quits.
Thidranki is no place for the timid. Come along anyway.
Taking our portal keep road to Thidranki Faste. Follow if you like.
Fighting for the Faste in Thidranki is the best thing at my level.
With you. Thidranki Faste will be ours.
Coming, saving my endurance for the gate.
Thidranki never gets old, does it.
I will take the walls, you take the gate.
Careful, their archers love the Faste towers.
Same thing happened to me in Thidranki last night.
Right then, let us show them how Thidranki is held.
Stay near the healers and you will be fine.
On my way. Keep the door standing.
Ha, the Faste always draws a crowd.
Good call. Group up first, then the Faste.
I have a few levels left in Thidranki too. Let us use them.
Aye, I will be there shortly.
We took it once, we can take it again.
Count on me for the next push.
Murdaigean is calling. Who wants to take Dun Murdaigean?
Twenty five and finally in Murdaigean. The fights here are fierce.
Murdaigean is where the groups get serious.
The {enemyrealm} hold Dun Murdaigean. Not for long.
Guild, Murdaigean run tonight. Healers especially welcome.
{guild} is pushing Dun Murdaigean. Join us at the portal keep.
Need defenders at Dun Murdaigean, they have a ram on the gate!
Lost two fights in Murdaigean. Won the third. That is progress.
Best mix of skill and chaos is right here in Murdaigean.
Holding the walls of Dun Murdaigean against a whole {enemyrealm} warband.
Murdaigean taught me that a good healer is worth three swords.
Saw a {enemyrealm} stealther sneak right past the Dun Murdaigean guards.
Twenty seven in Murdaigean, and I still feel outnumbered.
Our flag flies over Dun Murdaigean! Hold it, everyone!
Fights in Murdaigean end fast. Know your target before you charge.
Running a small roaming group through Murdaigean. Room for two more.
The road to Dun Murdaigean is a gauntlet tonight.
Door of Dun Murdaigean is cracking! Push, push, push!
Murdaigean is no joke. Bring potions.
Every {enemyrealm} in Murdaigean seems to know my name by now.
My first keep lord kill was in Murdaigean. Never forgetting it.
Watch the flanks around Dun Murdaigean. They come from the trees.
Two more levels in Murdaigean before Caledonia. Making the most of it.
Quiet in Murdaigean. Too quiet for my liking.
Took Dun Murdaigean back with just eight of us. Proud of this realm.
Healers in Murdaigean are a different breed. They never stop moving.
Lost Dun Murdaigean. Regroup at our portal keep and try again.
Assist the leader in Murdaigean or we fall apart.
Hold the bridge outside Dun Murdaigean and nobody gets past.
Nights in Murdaigean stretch late. One more fight, I keep saying.
Murdaigean is my favorite of them all. Fight me on it.
Coming to Murdaigean? Bring a friend. Bring two.
Guards at Dun Murdaigean are tough. Pull them away from the gate first.
Murdaigean feels like a small frontier. I love it.
Right with you. Dun Murdaigean falls tonight.
Heading over from the portal keep.
Murdaigean never disappoints.
Watch the trees, I got jumped there earlier.
Agreed. Stay tight and we win.
I will guard the healers on the way in.
Good, we need every blade in Murdaigean.
Same here. They just keep coming at the walls.
Hold on, nearly at the keep.
Ha, I remember my first night in Murdaigean too.
Then let us make it count.
Behind you. Lead the charge.
We will get it back, do not worry.
Keep calling targets, it helps.
I can stay a while longer. Let us go.
Caledonia tonight. Who wants to take Caer Caledon?
Caledonia is the last stop before the frontier. Make it count.
Thirty and finally in Caledonia. Caer Caledon, here I come.
Guild, Caledonia run tonight. Tanks and healers please.
{guild} is laying siege to Caer Caledon. Come help.
The {enemyrealm} have Caer Caledon. We will see about that.
Fights in Caledonia feel like real realm war now.
Need bodies at Caer Caledon, they have rams on both doors!
Veterans of Caledonia know every inch of this ground.
Holding the walls of Caer Caledon against two {enemyrealm} groups.
Here in Caledonia you learn whether you are ready for the frontier.
Our flag over Caer Caledon! Well fought, all!
Long nights in Caledonia, but worth it.
Saw a {enemyrealm} group of eight in perfect formation in Caledonia. Scary.
One more level and I leave Caledonia for good. Bittersweet.
The road to Caer Caledon is lined with stealthers tonight.
Caer Caledon door is down! Charge the lord!
Caledonia is no place to wander alone.
Patience wins in Caledonia. Wait for the group, then strike.
Lost Caer Caledon. Regroup at our portal keep.
Every fight in Caledonia feels like practice for the frontier keeps.
Small group roaming Caledonia. Looking for a healer and a caster.
Took Caer Caledon back with half a group. Not bad for us.
Healers in Caledonia are on another level. Wish I had one.
After Caledonia, the frontier. I hope I am ready.
Best fights at thirty are in Caledonia. Nobody can tell me otherwise.
The {enemyrealm} have a strong caster group in Caledonia. Watch out.
Guards of Caer Caledon hit hard. Pull them carefully.
Thirty three in Caledonia. I almost know what I am doing.
Watch the hills near Caer Caledon. Archers set up there every night.
Caledonia keeps me sharp. The frontier will not know what hit it.
Coming to Caledonia? Repair first, you will need it.
Holding Caer Caledon until the last of us falls.
Fights in Caledonia go on and on. I love every minute.
With you. Caer Caledon will not hold against us.
Coming over from the portal keep now.
Caledonia never lets you rest, does it.
Right, stay tight and follow the leader.
Careful, they have archers on the towers.
Same here. Long night of fighting ahead.
I will watch the healers while you push.
Good. Let us finish this before the frontier calls.
Hold on, I am nearly there.
Ha, Caledonia always draws a crowd.
We took it before, we take it again.
On my way. Keep them busy.
Agreed, wait for everyone first.
Count on me for the next charge.
Caledonia builds good fighters. Keep at it.
